purpose: Rank the complete-device component burden, remove avoidable pre-order penalties without functional degradation, and keep small-lot purchasing penalties separate from quantity-100 material cost.

community_cost_target.scope: repeatable complete base device excluding batteries and the optional full external antenna kit; PCB, PCBA and enclosure must fit in the remaining complete-device allowance
community_cost_target.rule: The target is a hard architecture gate, not a promise for the first one-off factory order. A one-off order also carries setup, MOQ, hand-solder, shipping and tax costs that cannot be amortized.

comparison_reference.finding: The published architecture is a much smaller one-S3 instrument: its shield BOM has three nRF24 modules, one CC1101 module, IR and a simple connector/passive layer. It is not burdened by Leshy2's two voice modules, Airband conversion chain, dual RP domains, three independent USB service paths, autonomous pack safety, actual-RF TX evidence and ten separately qualified RF ports. Retail volume and one-off factory procurement are also different price bases.

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: eight measurement-class RF detector ICs, five couplers and evidence conditioning
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain independent physical TX-present evidence for all three concurrently active nRF24 paths and fail-safe aggregate evidence for every other mutually exclusive TX group

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: sixteen premium tact switches, one pre-order battery holder and three premium opened-sandwich recovery headers
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain recessed serial controls, protected-cell tolerance and independently reachable recovery for S3, C5 and both RP domains

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: duplicated audio selectors, branch supervisors, evidence logic and safe-state support circuitry
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain every accepted capture/playback/PTT route, unattended hard shutdown, watchdog, three thermal zones and retained first-fault reason

working_architecture_savings.current_scope: five U.FL receptacles and five 30-mm microcoax jumpers
working_architecture_savings.contract: retain the same RF performance; current E01 and S3 module interfaces prevent removing four paths without changing the selected radio source

same_all_in_one_result.scope: same built-in user-visible functions and same safety outcome, excluding batteries and the full external antenna kit
same_all_in_one_result.confidence: planning envelope only; it assumes the paper-qualified USD 24.5068 replacements plus every unqualified architecture saving above, and adds USD 27-45 for PCB, PCBA and enclosure
same_all_in_one_result.assessment: USD 150 is not credible for the fully integrated current result without removing or externalizing hardware. A credible optimized target is roughly USD 220-260 for a repeatable complete base device; the sole first prototype remains higher.

modular_entry_result.scope: community entry device with the same software architecture and expansion compatibility, but selected specialist radio chains are bought as Caps/Units only when required
modular_entry_result.assessment: A USD 150 entry point is plausible only under this modular boundary. A fully populated system with every option and its antenna set still costs more.

cost_feasibility.decision_gate: Choose whether USD 150 governs a modular community entry device or whether all currently integrated radio chains must remain fitted; the latter needs a higher target.

display_orientation_review.accepted_rule: Physically orient the selected documented production panel so its flex points toward the antenna edge, then rotate display memory and touch coordinates in firmware. Do not allow the tail to enter the LED, D-pad or function-button zone.

accepted_cost_reduction_policy.primary_target: Eliminate avoidable small-lot pre-order penalties before reducing already-stocked material cost.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.stocked_replacement_rule: Prefer a currently stocked JLCPCB part only when the electrical, RF, safety, lifecycle and mechanical contract is exact or no worse. If no such part exists, keep the selected MPN and its explicit pre-order route.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.function_sensitive_rule: RF detectors, RF filters/couplers, power safety, battery protection and user-exposed ESD boundaries never change for price alone.
accepted_cost_reduction_policy.antenna_mechanics_rule: Prefer individually board-retained DIV-like right-angle SMA/RP-SMA bodies without nuts, sealing hardware or a shared protective frame. Low profile is not a requirement; a dual-face or through-board soldered load path is preferred. Keep the GCT pair only until a documented stocked standard/reverse pair passes the complete 5+5 placement, opposing-clearance and factory-assembly gate.

C167482 is live JLCPCB Standard-PCBA stock. The five-device line falls from USD 0.3620 to USD 0.2235, saving USD 0.1385; the quantity-100 material basis falls by USD 0.0277 per device.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Принято в H1-R2.29. Код G Murata сохраняет корпус LQW15AN 0402, номинал 56 нГн, Q, минимальный SRF 2,8 ГГц, ток 200 мА и максимальный DCR 1,17 Ом, одновременно ужесточая допуск с +/-5 % до +/-2 %. C167482 есть на складе JLCPCB для Standard PCBA. Строка пяти устройств снижается с $0,3620 до $0,2235, экономия $0,1385; серийная материальная база уменьшается на $0,0277 на устройство.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Economic and Standard PCBA
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The stocked member preserves the 6.6 x 6.0 x 4.3-mm body, 1.57-N feel, 500k endurance and IP67 family boundary, but removes the fifth cover-ground terminal. That can weaken the user-exposed ESD path, so the current B3S-1100P remains selected until an equivalent grounded stocked part is proven.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Складской вариант сохраняет корпус 6,6 × 6,0 × 4,3 мм, усилие 1,57 Н, ресурс 500 тысяч нажатий и IP67, но лишён пятого вывода заземления крышки. Это может ухудшить ESD-защиту доступной пользователю клавиши, поэтому B3S-1100P остаётся выбранной до доказательства равноценной складской замены.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Extended SMT; Economic and Standard PCBA
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: The JLCPCB cards prove a 6-GHz standard/reverse pair and the controlled HenryTech drawings prove individual retention without a nut, but both bodies point normal to the PCB. They do not replace the selected edge-facing GCT bodies without changing antenna direction and product form.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Карточки JLCPCB подтверждают standard/reverse-пару до 6 ГГц, а контролируемые чертежи HenryTech — индивидуальное удержание без гайки, но оба корпуса направлены перпендикулярно плате. Они не заменяют выбранные торцевые GCT без смены направления антенн и формы продукта.

current_stocked_candidate_checks.assembly_type: Plugin; JLCPCB page currently marks manualWeld; Standard PCBA route requires order review
current_stocked_candidate_checks.stock: 5479 pre-sale + 5588 overseas standard / 7 pre-sale + 42 overseas reverse
current_stocked_candidate_checks.trial_required_quantity: 8 standard / 2 reverse fitted; procurement minimum 13 standard / 12 reverse
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why: This is a fully documented, no-nut 6-GHz right-angle standard/reverse pair with a stronger through-board soldered load path. Its 9.7-mm body, five drilled pins and approximately 2.1-mm inner-side pin projection on a 1.6-mm PCB change the selected GCT keep-out, but low profile is no longer a product requirement. The live JLCPCB cards on 2026-08-29 show a Plugin/manualWeld route, procurement minima of 13/12 and only overseas/pre-sale availability rather than ordinary SMT stock. It remains the leading mechanical candidate, not an accepted production MPN: all ten placements, opposing clearances and written factory assembly acceptance must pass together.
current_stocked_candidate_checks.why_ru: Это полностью документированная standard/reverse-пара до 6 ГГц без гаек и с более прочным сквозным путём передачи нагрузки. Корпус 9,7 мм, пять просверленных выводов и выступание ножек примерно на 2,1 мм с внутренней стороны платы 1,6 мм меняют keep-out выбранных GCT, но низкий профиль больше не является требованием. Текущие карточки JLCPCB на 2026-08-29 показывают маршрут Plugin/manualWeld, минимальную закупку 13/12 и только overseas/pre-sale availability вместо обычного SMT-склада. Это остаётся ведущим механическим кандидатом, но не принятым production MPN: должны одновременно пройти все десять размещений, встречные зазоры и письменное подтверждение фабричной установки.

optimization_lanes.title: Rebuild the external antenna kit from stocked no-worse equivalents
optimization_lanes.evidence: Eight of twelve exact first-target antenna profiles already contribute USD 138.3166 per device, while three nRF24 antennas and the controlled AM/LW receive pod remain unpriced. This is the largest separate material group even though it sits outside the base PCBA BOM.
optimization_lanes.action: Keep every accepted band and all band-specific TX matching. Search the current factory/order surface for exact or no-worse connector, band, power and matching equivalents; optimize receive-only profiles separately and never silently substitute one generic whip for a qualified TX antenna.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace safe equivalent pre-order passives and ordinary logic with in-stock JLCPCB parts
optimization_lanes.evidence: After six safe replacement batches, 26 pre-order rows cost USD 648.0444 in the normalized five-device evidence versus USD 322.6465 on their quantity-100 material basis. The stocked Nexperia, YAGEO, UNI-ROYAL, FH, Hirose, TI, Vishay and Murata routes together remove approximately USD 137.7020 from the observed trial route and reduce the public material basis by a net USD 3.0885 per device.
optimization_lanes.action: Review every pre-order row against its substitution class; only exact or no-worse parametric replacements may be accepted.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace the expensive GCT pair with a robust stocked standard/reverse pair if it fits
optimization_lanes.evidence: Ten GCT RFPC-SMA31/32 connectors contribute USD 24.6456 per device. Low profile is no longer a product requirement; the DreamLNK nutless pair would reduce the line by about USD 19.02 on the common quantity-100 basis, but its through-hole tails, procurement minima and manual factory-soldering route require a new internal keep-out and written assembly acceptance.
optimization_lanes.action: Optimize for the correct outward antenna direction, standard/RP-SMA identity, at least 6-GHz coverage on native ports and a dual-face or through-board mechanical load path. Accept a replacement only after complete 5+5 placement, opposing-clearance and assembly review.

optimization_lanes.title: Re-evaluate eight RF power detectors without weakening real-TX evidence
optimization_lanes.evidence: Six AD8314 plus two LTC5532 contribute USD 24.9174 per device on the common quantity-100 basis; the historical live five-device requirement is USD 276.70. Stocked same-device AD8314ARMZ-REEL C652687 would save USD 88.99 on that historical EVT5 snapshot and USD 5.4864 per finished device on the same quantity-100 basis. No strict no-worse LTC5532 replacement is proved.
optimization_lanes.action: Register and collision-check all six larger MSOP courtyards, adjacent match/bypass bodies and RF-ground fanout before accepting C652687. Keep the two LTC5532 and independent evidence for the three concurrently active nRF24 paths.

optimization_lanes.title: Find one serial in-stock tact-switch family for all sixteen ordinary controls
optimization_lanes.evidence: B3S-1100P contributes USD 10.248 per device at quantity 100 and USD 74.58 for 80 pieces in the five-device pre-order route. The first stocked candidate was rejected because it removes the grounded cover terminal.
optimization_lanes.action: Preserve footprint/enclosure reach, force, height, endurance, the ESD boundary and recessed actuation.

optimization_lanes.title: Retain all five U.FL plus 30-mm jumper paths after source-to-port review
optimization_lanes.evidence: The five paths contribute USD 14.433 per device at quantity 100, before assembly handling. S3 and all three E01 modules expose only microcoax RF outputs, and each path must still pass through its local coupler and real-TX detector before SMA. The current C5 module also exposes U.FL; an exact stocked Espressif T2/ANT2 factory route is not proved.
optimization_lanes.action: Therefore 0/5 paths can be removed safely now. A future qualified C5 T2 route could remove one path and save about USD 2.89 per device.

optimization_lanes.title: Compare the 1048P holder with serial cell contacts captured by the enclosure cradle
optimization_lanes.evidence: 1048P contributes USD 8.57 per device at quantity 100 and is currently stock-zero pre-order at JLCPCB.
optimization_lanes.action: Any replacement must keep protected-cell length tolerance, polarity, insertion cycles and a non-peeling enclosure load path.

optimization_lanes.title: Replace three premium DBG10 headers with an equally keyed serial factory-stocked family
optimization_lanes.evidence: Three Samtec FTSH headers contribute USD 5.0973 per device and exist only as opened-sandwich recovery fallbacks.
optimization_lanes.action: Preserve independent S3/C5/RP recovery, keying, pitch, probe access and the internal height envelope.

optimization_lanes.title: Do not optimize away the selected serial production panel
optimization_lanes.evidence: EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 contributes USD 14.91 and already provides a controlled drawing, ILI9488/FT6236, direct i8080-8 and quantity-one serial ordering. The donor route is gone.
optimization_lanes.action: Treat the display material cost as justified. Only the assembler fee and written acceptance of panel/FPC final mating remain open; do not restart display selection for a small speculative saving.
